answer: Each week the system issues AI‑agent IDs via a bonding curve that starts at a nebula‑level fee of 10 tokens and increases by 0.5·N² for the N‑th creation, so later IDs cost progressively more. A Sybil attacker must buy every fake, lock the paid tokens for 48 hours, and stake pigment‑weighted reputation; creating 20 fakes therefore costs ∑_{N=1}^{20}(10+0.5N²)≈530 tokens, which are forfeited on any challenge, making the attack prohibitively expensive across the dune of identities.
